name: Chicken Caesar Egg Smash
notes:
Everything you love about a Caesar in one loaded egg mayo smash: roast chicken, salty anchovies, sharp Parmesan and Dijon, wrapped in iceberg lettuce.

Ingredients (whole batch):
• 2 chicken breasts
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 9 eggs
• 1½ tbsp 5% fat Greek yoghurt
• 3 tbsp mayonnaise
• 1½ tbsp Dijon mustard
• 1 × 30g tin anchovies in olive oil
• 1 tsp anchovy oil
• 1 lemon
• 30g Parmesan
• 15g fresh chives
• Salt
• Black pepper
• 9 leaves iceberg lettuce

Method:
1. Heat the oven to 200°C. Put the chicken breasts on a baking tray, drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper. Roast for 15–20 mins, until cooked through, then cool slightly before shredding or chopping.
2. Meanwhile, bring a pan of water to the boil. Lower in the eggs and cook for 8 mins. Cool in cold water, then peel. If you like, separate the yolks from the whites.
3. Add the eggs to a large bowl with the Greek yoghurt, mayonnaise and Dijon. Finely chop the anchovies and add them with the anchovy oil. Grate in the Parmesan, zest in the lemon and squeeze in the juice. Finely chop the chives and add most of them, saving a little to serve. Season, then smash everything together with a pizza cutter.
4. Add the shredded chicken and fold through.
5. For each serving, lay out 2–3 slightly overlapping iceberg leaves, dollop in a portion of the smash and roll up like a wrap. Cut in half and serve. Prepped ahead, the smash keeps in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 3 days.

Nutrition is Mob's figure per serving, as served in the recipe. Also per serving: saturated fat 9g, fibre 1g, sugars 2g, sodium 1171mg.

Source: https://www.mob.co.uk/recipes/high-protein-chicken-caesar-egg-smash
